pages.title: Hex Mine 3D
pages.creator: Lucas Entertainment Studio
pages.description: Hex Mine 3D wraps a mine-clearing puzzle around a globe of hexagonal tiles. Rotate the world, read the neighboring-mine counts and reveal safe spaces while flagging suspected mines. Clear the required tiles without triggering an explosion to complete the level.

pages.title: Pato Vs Cops
pages.creator: GMG
pages.description: Pato vs Cops puts you in a car chase with police and roadblocks closing in. Steer with the arrow keys, dodge obstacles and collect power-ups during the pursuit. Keep finding open road to extend the escape attempt.

pages.title: Wire Connect
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Wire Connect asks you to draw safe electrical paths from devices to power sockets. Keep the lines away from water, people and other hazards before activating the current. Complete every connection without a short circuit, redrawing a route when necessary.

pages.title: Dream Mania Happy Match
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Dream Mania Happy Match gives you matching puzzles with individual level goals. Bring at least three identical items together to clear them from the board. Choose combinations that help complete the requested objective as the arrangement changes.

pages.title: Smash the Car to Pieces!
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Smash the Car to Pieces! turns a car into a destruction target for guns, drones and other tools. Damage the vehicle to earn rewards, then buy improvements for later attacks. Rotate the view and zoom to inspect another part of the wreck.

pages.title: Ball and Girlfriend
pages.creator: Jeka-505
pages.description: Ball and Girlfriend sends a ball searching for the key to its girlfriend's cage. Cross platform levels filled with enemies and hazards, collecting hearts to restore health. Look for hidden emeralds along secret routes and prepare for the final boss encounter.

pages.title: Traffic Jam Hop On
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Traffic Jam Hop On asks you to clear vehicles from a congested parking area. Select the cars that have an open route and free space for those still blocked. Plan the departure order so the remaining traffic can continue moving.

pages.title: Flames & Fortune
pages.creator: RavalMatic
pages.description: Flames and Fortune puts a Pyro-Paladin into a dungeon represented by a deck of cards. Equip resources in your hands and backpack, then deal with monsters using spells, shields or direct damage. Clear the deck and gather gold to unlock more skills.

pages.title: Wheel of Bingo
pages.creator: Andrew Wolf
pages.description: Wheel of Bingo combines number matching with a second ball-dropping stage. Spin the wheel to mark bingo numbers and earn colored balls, gaining extras for a full line. Drop those balls through the plinko board and match the landing colors for score multipliers.

pages.title: Stickman Shooter Bros
pages.creator: Byte Blasters
pages.description: Stickman Shooter Bros gives you three fighters and weapons with different effects for top-down battles. Move through the levels and use options such as a minigun, shotgun, lava gun or stunning tesla weapon. Deal with enemy groups before confronting the bosses.

pages.title: Egg Adventure
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Egg Adventure presents puzzle scenes where an egg needs a way to the exit door. Manipulate the character or surroundings and look for clues in words and actions. Work out the particular trick that opens the route through each stage.

pages.title: Solitaire Mahjong Candy 2
pages.creator: SOFTGAMES – Mobile Entertainment Services GmbH
pages.description: Solitaire Mahjong Candy 2 asks you to remove matching candy tiles that are not blocked by other pieces. Clear the arrangement within eight minutes and use tools such as shuffle, undo or hints when needed. Select another layout to try a different board.

pages.title: Only Up Parkour
pages.creator: NISHAD_Games
pages.description: Only Up Parkour sends a character climbing a vertical maze of obstacles. Run and jump between surfaces while watching for moving platforms and rotating hazards. Keep the landings precise so a missed step does not send the climber falling.

pages.title: Mia Swept-Back Bridal Hairstyle
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Mia Swept-Back Bridal Hairstyle helps Mia prepare her hair for her wedding. Choose a bridal style with the hair swept back, then work through the available styling activities. Complete the look before she gets ready for the ceremony.

pages.title: Bubble Strike
pages.creator: AGED STUDIO LIMITED
pages.description: Bubble Strike asks you to aim colored bubbles into groups of at least three. Bounce shots off the walls to reach awkward positions and use lightning or sun bombs to clear sections. Complete the board with fewer shots to improve the score.

pages.title: Extreme Drift Car Simulator
pages.creator: Driving games
pages.description: Extreme Drift Car Simulator gives you sports cars to customize and drive through open maps. Explore the roads, modify the chosen vehicle and hold controlled slides to earn drift points. Keep practicing the balance between steering, acceleration and braking.

pages.title: Dot Crusher
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Dot Crusher gives you a ball and two bars that must both be touched in one shot. Click the ball to choose the strength and trajectory, then release the move. Find a path that reaches both targets to advance to the next level.

pages.title: Steampunk
pages.creator: Booblyc OU
pages.description: Steampunk turns removing objects into a physics rescue puzzle. Break wooden boxes, set off bombs and use the resulting movement to bring friendly characters onto the safe surface. Send villains off the screen while keeping the heroes in play.

pages.title: Rope Puzzle
pages.creator: Rokito Games
pages.description: Rope Puzzle asks you to cut ropes so a suspended ball reaches the cans in each scene. Choose the release order and account for the ball's movement around obstacles. Knock away the targets to complete the level's arrangement.

pages.title: Frontline
pages.creator: 2Play
pages.description: Frontline combines shooting units with merging as hostile creatures attack. Click a shooter to send it into action and combine matching units to create a stronger one. Build a force that can survive the pressure from the approaching enemies.

pages.title: Ice Queen
pages.creator: Functu
pages.description: Ice Queen takes you through a frozen world with levels to explore. Use the arrows to move and interact with objects while collecting ice creams and sweets. Work past the obstacles that stand between the character and the next part of the journey.

pages.title: Milk Crate Challenge
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Milk Crate Challenge asks you to walk a character up and down a tower of stacked crates. Move slowly with the mouse or a finger and keep the climber balanced. A fall ends the attempt, so judge each step before advancing.

pages.title: Craftsman Hidden Items
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Craftsman Hidden Items conceals ten faded objects in each illustrated scene. Examine the area and select the items that are difficult to distinguish from the background. Find the full set before moving on to the next picture.

pages.title: 10x10 Block Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: 10x10 Block Puzzle asks you to drag jewel-block shapes onto a square grid. Fill complete lines to remove them and open room for the next pieces. Keep space for the three offered shapes, since the game ends when none can fit.

pages.title: Ball Maze
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Ball Maze asks you to rotate a two-dimensional labyrinth so the ball reaches every balloon. Touch and drag to change the level's angle and let the ball move through the passages. Pop the full set of balloons to finish the maze.

pages.title: Open Restaurant
pages.creator: Ramblo Digital Media
pages.description: Open Restaurant puts you in charge of seating customers and serving their meals. Select an available table, take the order and bring food when it is ready. Collect the payment and choose the next task quickly to keep the restaurant running.

pages.title: Santa Delivery
pages.creator: MathNook
pages.description: Santa Delivery gives you a sleigh to steer between homes while snowmen chase behind. Follow the delivery marker, collect coins and hearts, and use a speed burst when needed. Avoid trees and pursuers, then improve the sleigh in the garage.

pages.title: BFF Christmas Travel Recommendation
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: BFF Christmas Travel Recommendation helps Emma and Clara choose a destination for their Christmas celebration. Pick a place to visit, then coordinate festive outfits and accessories for both friends. Complete their travel looks before the holiday trip.

pages.title: Retro Cars Coloring
pages.creator: STA network
pages.description: Retro Cars Coloring offers eight classic-car drawings and a palette of 23 colors. Choose a picture and fill the different areas to create a finished design. Work toward the game's coloring score or save the completed image.

pages.title: Curvy Punch 3D
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Curvy Punch 3D puts you into fights where obstacles stand between your punches and the enemy. Aim the attacks to break through barriers and reach the opponent. Change position to avoid the fists coming back toward your character.

pages.title: Baby Supermarket
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Baby Supermarket follows a panda child and mother on a shopping trip. Explore the animal supermarket and help them complete the shopping activities. Use clicks or taps to interact with the items and continue through the store.

pages.title: Combat Strike Zombie Survival Multiplayer
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames.com
pages.description: Combat Strike Zombie Survival Multiplayer puts you against armed soldiers and zombies in shooting battles. Move, aim and change weapons while working through the available modes and missions. Earn experience and ranks to unlock characters and additional guns.

pages.title: Pizzaiolo
pages.creator: bestgames.com
pages.description: Pizzaiolo puts you behind a pizza counter with customer orders to complete. Choose the dough, seasoning and toppings requested for each pizza, paying attention to the details. Serve accurately and quickly to keep customers satisfied and earn money.

pages.title: Animals Cards Memory
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Animals Cards Memory hides animal pictures behind a grid of cards. Reveal two at a time, remember their positions and match identical pairs. Clear the full board within the time limit as the layouts become more demanding.

pages.title: Family Relics
pages.creator: INFINITE
pages.description: Family Relics gives you the Parsley estate to restore in Willow Hills. Clear the grounds, build up the farm, grow crops and tend animals while following the area's unusual story. Explore the mysteries surrounding the family's treasured relics as the farm develops.

pages.title: Gladiator Kampf
pages.creator: Kostenlose Spiele
pages.description: Gladiator Kampf puts you in an arena with weapons and armor for gladiatorial combat. Move around the opponent, attack or block and choose between equipment such as a sword, shield, bow or two-handed weapon. Use the available movement options to manage each encounter.

pages.title: Impossible Bus Stunt 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Impossible Bus Stunt 3D sends buses onto large ramps and difficult stunt courses. Choose a vehicle, accelerate along the track and handle the obstacles ahead. Complete challenges to unlock more of the available buses.

pages.title: Shark Hunting
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Shark Hunting challenges you to aim guns at shark targets. Move the mouse to line up a shot, use the zoom view for a closer look and fire when the aim is clear. Switch weapons with the scroll wheel while trying to earn more points.

pages.title: Lovable Little Creatures Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Lovable Little Creatures Puzzle offers six animal pictures to rebuild at four difficulty settings. Select 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces and reconnect the selected scene. Look for matching faces, outlines and background details to guide each placement.

pages.title: Galaxy Stones
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Galaxy Stones asks you to reveal a glass barrier at the moment a ball needs support. Tap too early or too late and the ball can fall away. Watch its approach and keep timing the barrier to extend the run.

pages.title: My Supermarket Story
pages.creator: TrendyGames
pages.description: My Supermarket Story lets you manage a store's activities, expenses and income. Work with departments selling groceries, toys and clothing as you develop the supermarket. A fruit-slicing minigame adds another activity during the business routine.

pages.title: Neon Race
pages.creator: DarknesGamesStudio
pages.description: Neon Race turns driving into a timing challenge around colored lines. Cross the yellow line to earn points while keeping the car away from green ones. Touch to control the vehicle and continue finding the safe route.

pages.title: Horseman
pages.creator: Online Games io
pages.description: Horseman puts a mounted cowboy into a world filled with zombies. Choose a horse and fight with a bow, sword or gun while exploring the available areas. Mount or dismount as needed and keep the undead from overwhelming the rider.

pages.title: Two For 2 match the numbers!
pages.creator: LDGEngineering
pages.description: Two for 2 asks you to connect numbered points into chains that produce doubled values. Longer lines earn more points while each merge creates a larger number. Keep useful connections available so you do not run out of moves before reaching a higher value.

pages.title: Super Police Jigsaw
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Super Police Jigsaw offers twelve police-themed pictures as jigsaw puzzles. Choose 25, 49 or 100 pieces and fit the scattered sections together. Use recognizable vehicles, figures and background edges to restore the chosen image.

pages.title: BTS Shoe Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Shoe Coloring gives you shoe illustrations to decorate with a brush. Select colors and apply them to the different parts of a design. Try a different palette to turn the same drawing into another finished style.

pages.title: Tank Attack
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Tank Attack asks you to destroy the opposing tanks while protecting your own vehicle's health. Aim with the mouse and choose between gunfire, a machine gun or napalm bombs. Use walls for protection before moving out for another attack.

pages.title: Arkadium's 5roll
pages.creator: Arkadium
pages.description: Arkadium's 5roll turns five dice into a combination-scoring challenge. Roll and look for results such as pairs, three of a kind, full houses or straights. Choose the useful combinations and try to finish with a higher score.

pages.title: Fishy Differences
pages.creator: MBG Network
pages.description: Fishy Differences asks you to find seven changes in each pair of fish-themed pictures. Search the animals and scenery before the one-minute timer runs out. Complete the full set of differences to continue through the levels.

pages.title: Bomber 3D
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: Bomber 3D puts two players into bomb battles across four arenas. Move around the field and place explosives while keeping clear of their blasts. Use separate keyboard controls to trap your friend's character before your own fighter is caught.

pages.title: Fruit Juice Maker
pages.creator: BestCrazyGames
pages.description: Fruit Juice Maker lets you prepare juices and smoothies for customers. Work through the drink-making activities and serve the requested refreshments. Keep checking what the next customer wants as you continue behind the counter.

pages.title: Karma SC1 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Karma SC1 Puzzle turns six car pictures into jigsaws with four piece-count options. Choose 16, 36, 64 or 100 pieces, then rebuild the selected vehicle scene. Match bodywork and background details to find where the sections belong.

pages.title: Fruit Cocktail Memory
pages.creator: Shunda Inc
pages.description: Fruit Cocktail Memory hides matching pictures behind face-down tiles. Reveal pairs, remember their locations and clear the layout in as few moves as possible. Work through four levels as the next arrangement tests another set of remembered positions.

pages.title: clash royale free
pages.creator: fugames
pages.description: Clash Royale Free puts you in a forest threatened by attacking monsters. Move to the blue building areas and construct defensive towers to protect the surroundings. Rebuild destroyed defenses and use the summoner's special skill when the enemy pressure becomes difficult to manage.

pages.title: Draw Curve
pages.creator: igroutka.ru
pages.description: Draw Curve asks you to connect dots into a complete shape without lifting the drawing stroke. Study the available routes before starting and choose an order that finishes the pattern. Work through the increasingly difficult one-stroke puzzles.

pages.title: Mortar Watermelon
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Mortar Watermelon asks you to aim a watermelon through fruit pickups and toward the target. Set up a route that collects the required fruit before the shot finishes. Adjust the next attempt when the first trajectory misses part of the arrangement.

pages.title: Goof Runner
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Goof Runner sends a character along an obstacle-filled running route. React to the next hazard and use the mouse controls to keep clear of it. Continue farther without a collision to improve the attempt.

pages.title: Dinosaurs World Hidden Eggs Part IV
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Dinosaurs World Hidden Eggs Part IV hides dinosaur eggs within illustrated scenes. Examine each picture and click the concealed eggs before the timer expires. Clear the five levels while trying to increase the search score.

pages.title: Stick Soldier
pages.creator: Aningame
pages.description: Stick Soldier makes an extending stick the route between platforms. Hold to grow it and release when it looks long enough for the next crossing. Judge the gap carefully, since a short bridge leaves the soldier with nowhere to land.

pages.title: Chained Tractor Towing Train Simulator
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Chained Tractor Towing Train Simulator gives you a tractor to pull a train engine along railway tracks. Hook up the load and drive with WASD to complete the towing challenge. Buy or upgrade tractors to prepare for further pulling events.

pages.title: Dinosaur Memory Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Dinosaur Memory Challenge asks you to uncover pairs of matching dinosaur pictures. Turn over cards, remember the positions and clear the complete arrangement. Choose easy, medium, hard or expert mode for a different memory challenge.

pages.title: EG Flip Gun
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Flip Gun uses a weapon's recoil to make it rise through the air. Time shots to keep the gun flying and choose its next direction of travel. Try different firearms while working toward a higher ascent.

pages.title: BTS Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: BTS Coloring Book offers pictures for you to color in your own way. Select a drawing, choose a palette and fill its different sections. Experiment with another combination to give the finished picture a different appearance.

pages.title: EG Explode Ball
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: EG Explode Ball challenges you to bounce between side walls without touching spikes. Tap to control the jump height and look for a safe section on the next wall. Avoid the fully spiked top and bottom boundaries as the side hazards change.

pages.title: Stickman Vector
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickman Vector sends a stickman through platform stages with deadly traps. Use moves such as wall climbing and pushing crates to open a path forward. Time each movement around the hazards to reach the end of the stage.

pages.title: Bus Differences
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Bus Differences asks you to find seven changes between paired bus pictures. Examine the vehicles and backgrounds before the one-minute timer expires. Locate every mismatch in the current scene to unlock the next level.

pages.title: Hidden Object Game
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Hidden Object Game challenges you to find the pictured objects within a crowded scene. Select the targets shown along the top bar before the timer runs out. Use a hint when needed and clear the round to face another collection of hidden items.

pages.title: Helen
pages.creator: Rumata Lab
pages.description: Helen gives you a wardrobe of outfits to try on the title character. Browse the available pieces and choose a combination that works together. Compare different looks before settling on the finished outfit.

pages.title: Ice Queen Sauna Flirting
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ice Queen Sauna Flirting helps the Ice Queen prepare for a sauna date and an evening out. Follow the relaxation activities, add oils and steam, and set the scene for the couple. Finish by choosing an outfit for her night after the sauna.

pages.title: 12 Days of Xmas
pages.creator: La Ventanita
pages.description: 12 Days of Xmas turns seasonal pictures into a matching puzzle. Arrange identical festive pieces into groups of three and keep finding combinations as the board changes. Work through the holiday challenge while trying to improve the result.

pages.title: Love Bears
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Love Bears asks you to draw physical objects that bring two bears together. Sketch lines or shapes to nudge the characters toward one another and account for how gravity moves them. Complete the puzzle to earn stars for the level.

pages.title: Jumpee Land
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Jumpee Land follows a yellow bird hopping between three-dimensional platforms. Time the jumps around lasers, breaking tiles and other traps as the route changes. Travel farther to improve the run and unlock additional animal characters.

pages.title: Traffic
pages.creator: pogames.in
pages.description: Traffic asks you to get across a road without being hit by passing vehicles. Watch for a safe gap and move only when the route opens. Keep checking the next lane before continuing the crossing.

pages.title: Dinogen Arena
pages.creator: Wilkin Games
pages.description: Dinogen Arena is a top-down shooter with human and dinosaur teams. Fight in ranked modes to unlock weapons and equipment, or defend against increasingly difficult dinosaur waves in Survival. Build a stronger position with support such as turrets and reinforcements.

pages.title: Pocket Wings WW2
pages.creator: WITCHHUT LLC
pages.description: Pocket Wings WW2 puts you in a stunt plane for a series of training courses. Fly through every ring in order while avoiding the obstacles in the air. Complete the route before time runs out to pass the level.

pages.title: Princess St Patrick's Party
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Princess St Patrick's Party helps princesses prepare outfits for their holiday outing. Browse the clothing, hairstyles and accessories, then coordinate a look for each character. Complete the party preparations with the available fashion choices.

pages.title: Star Smash
pages.creator: Kizi
pages.description: Star Smash turns matching cards into a puzzle based on their colors and shapes. Find combinations that share the required features and use them to continue the challenge. Check both properties before choosing the next group of cards.

pages.title: Ice Princess Doll House
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Ice Princess Doll House lets you decorate rooms inside an ice-castle dollhouse. Arrange spaces such as the sisters' bedrooms, kitchen, bathroom and attic with the available furnishings. Give each room a finished design while developing the whole royal home.

pages.title: BFF Street Dancing
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: BFF Street Dancing helps Aurora and her friends prepare a poster for a dance show. Mix clothing and hairstyles for the princesses, then choose a stage background for the finished scene. Coordinate the looks to present their street-dancing theme.

pages.title: Highschool Crush
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Highschool Crush helps Elsa get ready for a school day when she will see Jack. Choose her makeup and coordinate an outfit from the available wardrobe. Complete the styling activities before the couple meets at school.

pages.title: BattleCube.online
pages.creator: WI Games
pages.description: BattleCube.online puts block-like fighters into online shooting rooms. Create a match by choosing a map and round length, or join a battle already underway. Move through the arena and fight the opposing players until the round ends.

pages.title: BB TIN
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: BB TIN puts you in control of a snake-like chain of balls. Change direction to collect pickups that add more balls and hit numbered blocks for points. Keep the chain away from walls, since contact with the boundary ends the attempt.

pages.title: My Dolphin Show 4
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: My Dolphin Show 4 puts a dolphin under your control for aquarium tricks. Use the arrow keys to jump through rings and move up or down through the water. Work through the performance activities to complete the show's challenges.

pages.title: Prom Perfect Make-up
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Prom Perfect Make-up helps you prepare a princess's face and hair for prom. Choose foundation, add eye shadow and adjust the cosmetic details to suit the desired look. Finish with a hairstyle that complements the makeup.

pages.title: Princess Party At The Castle
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Princess Party at the Castle gives you princesses to dress for a Christmas celebration. Coordinate dresses, gloves, hair accessories and shoes from the available choices. Combine the colors to complete each character's winter party outfit.

pages.title: Sery Magazine Dolly Dress Up H5
pages.creator: GlossyPlay
pages.description: Sery Magazine Dolly Dress Up H5 asks you to style Sery for a magazine cover. Pair clothing with hairstyles and aim for a high outfit score. Unlock achievements and save a picture of the look you like best.

pages.title: Ice Princess Nail Design
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Ice Princess Nail Design combines nail care with a decorative manicure. Work through the cream, filing and clipping activities, then choose a shape, colors and nail accessories. Add rings and bracelets to complete the princess's finished style.
